name: foreach_addcdiv_tensor
description: Representative ATen operator aten::_foreach_addcdiv.Tensor. Migrated from the shared foreach family suite on FlagGems master commit c778fea4. The tests cover three heterogeneous tensor-list shapes, float16/float32/bfloat16 accuracy against the exact ATen overload, empty lists, and TensorList length, shape, dtype, value, and non-aliasing.
